Robotics Engineering · TechTics

BB

A VR-controlled mobile robot designed for remote operation on the beach, combining immersive visual feedback, robotic manipulation and onboard safety sensing.

VR Teleoperation Robotic Arm Camera Streaming LiDAR Motors System Integration
VR control Immersive teleoperation of both the mobile platform and the robotic arm
Head-coupled camera Camera orientation follows the operator's head movement for more natural viewing
LiDAR safety Onboard sensing layer to support safer remote operation

Project

Remote operation with natural visual feedback

BB was developed as a remotely operated beach robot. The system combines a mobile platform, a robotic arm and a VR-based control interface so that an operator can drive the robot, manipulate objects and monitor the environment from a distance.

A key idea in the project was to make the interaction feel more intuitive: when the operator moves their head in VR, the robot's camera moves with it, creating a more direct and natural way to look around the environment.

System

Three parts of the concept

Robot platform

Mobile base with large wheels, an onboard robotic arm and the hardware needed for remote operation and sensing.

VR interface

Live camera view and control interface presented in VR, enabling remote driving and interaction with the robot.

Human–robot interaction

The operator teleoperates the system from a distance while camera motion follows head movement for a more intuitive experience.

Control flow

From operator input to robot action

01 VR input

The operator controls the system using a VR headset and handheld controllers.

02 Communication

Control commands and video data are exchanged between operator and robot.

03 Robot motion

The drive system and robotic arm respond to the teleoperation commands.

04 Visual feedback

The onboard camera stream is sent back to the user, with the camera following head movement.

05 Safety layer

LiDAR contributes environmental awareness as an additional safety function.

My contribution

Integration across hardware and software

  • Worked on the integration of the robot subsystems
  • Contributed to LiDAR-related functionality and safety sensing
  • Worked with motors and drive-related components
  • Worked on camera streams and remote visual feedback
  • Contributed to the telecommunication between operator and robot
  • Contributed to the VR-based control concept
  • Worked on the robotic-arm side of the overall platform
  • Supported prototyping, system testing and debugging
This project was highly multidisciplinary. My contribution focused mainly on integration and development across the hardware/software boundary rather than on one isolated subsystem.
